Article 6.4: MAX Funded Account Resets

Warren's summary

Summarize this rule
Overview

Standard MAX and STEADY funded accounts offer a one-time reset option for traders whose Sim-Funded account has failed. This article covers who is eligible, what the reset costs, and exactly how the process works.

Important: This reset applies to Sim-Funded MAX accounts only. FFN Institution accounts cannot be reset under any circumstances.

Am I Eligible for a MAX Funded Account Reset?

You are eligible for a MAX funded account reset if all three of the following conditions are met:

Your account number begins with EPS or EPV (these are MAX funded account prefixes).
You have not yet received a payout on that account. Once any payout has been processed on an account, the reset option for that account is permanently forfeited.
You have not previously reset this account. Each account is eligible for one reset only.

OG funded accounts are not eligible. If your account number starts with 7PV, it is an OG funded account and cannot be reset. You will need to restart the evaluation process.

Retired Express MAX accounts are not eligible. Express MAX was retired on July 1, 2026 and replaced by STEADY. Once a retired Express MAX account is blown, it cannot be reset. The funded reset option applies to Standard MAX and STEADY accounts only.

How to Identify Your Account Type
Account Number Prefix	Account Type	Funded Reset Eligible?
EPS	MAX Funded (Standard MAX or Express MAX)	Yes: eligible
EPV	MAX Funded (Standard MAX or Express MAX)	Yes: eligible
7PV	OG Funded (Standard OG or Express OG)	No: not eligible
Reset Fees
Account Size	Reset Fee
25K Funded	$475
50K Funded	$625
100K Funded	$1,250
150K Funded	$1,875
250K Funded	$3,125
What Happens After a Reset?

After paying the reset fee, your MAX funded account restarts from the beginning. You will need to rebuild from scratch under all standard funded account rules for your account type.

An account reset on or after October 22, 2026 follows the payout caps (Article 5.3) and the high-frequency trading rule (Article 3.8) for accounts purchased on or after October 22, 2026.

If the account fails again after the reset, the reset option is no longer available. You would need to restart the entire evaluation process from the beginning.

Key Rules at a Glance
Sim-Funded only. FFN Institution accounts cannot be reset.
No prior payout. If a payout has been received on the account, the reset option is not available.
One reset per account. Each funded account can only be reset once.
EPS and EPV prefixes only. Accounts starting with 7PV are not eligible.
Restarts from scratch. All progress, profit, and buffer are reset to the initial funded account state.
Frequently Asked Questions

Can I reset a MAX funded account if I've already made a withdrawal?
No. Once any payout has been processed on that account, the reset option is permanently forfeited for that account.

Can I reset a Standard OG or Express OG funded account?
No. OG funded accounts (account numbers starting with 7PV) are not eligible for funded account resets.

My account number starts with EPS but I've already reset it once. Can I reset again?
No. Each account is eligible for one reset only. After the reset is used, you must restart the full evaluation process if the account fails again.

Does the reset fee change if I have a discount code?
Contact support to confirm whether any active promotions apply to funded account reset fees.
